PostgreSQL, read-only. Query the views in schema `redacted` (it is the reader role's default search_path, so unqualified names work). Names are written as SQL needs them: a name in double quotes is case-sensitive and works only with its quotes. A view named like a `pg_catalog` relation, or like a temporary table you created, is shadowed in unqualified queries: qualify it with the schema. Only the columns listed here exist; every other column was removed on purpose. Statements time out after 15s.
